name: @dialpad/dialtone-mcp-server

tools.name: search_utility_classes
tools.description: Search CSS utility classes with their available properties and usage.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Search design tokens with three named theme samples and usage. For all available theme records, use projection themes with an exact returned token name.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search components by name or feature with sampled APIs and import hints. Use get_component for complete APIs. Source-example hints accompany matching subjects; use search_documentation for longer example requests.

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search icons by name, category or keyword with component import examples from @dialpad/dialtone-icons/vue.

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search documentation prose about usage, accessibility, migrations or design guidance, including longer example requests. Source sections list available examples/* IDs. Use get_documentation for complete prose or an exact example.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Retrieve one selected component’s complete available contract or named field: types/defaults, all allowed and deprecated values, required inputs, event payloads, scoped-slot bindings, methods/exposed members, verified export hints and qualified latest documentation links. Selection never substitutes a feature-search candidate; absent metadata is unknown.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Retrieve complete available prose for an exact documentation section ID. Follow the returned textOffset continuation to read remaining content. Offsets count Unicode code points. Selected examples/* IDs include complete source-derived files and setup; check their pinned consumer profile and validation limits. A continued fragment is not a complete runnable example.

instructions: Search with search_components, search_icons, search_tokens, search_utility_classes or search_documentation for summaries. APIs/themes are samples. Use get_component for selected APIs, get_documentation for exact prose or source-example IDs, and search_tokens projection themes. Follow continuations. Data uses configured installations or bundled data; documentation/examples use bundled data; installed compatibility is not checked. Search documentation for longer example requests; sections give example IDs. Inspect versions, hashes and missing metadata. Import hints verify exports only. Documentation links are latest references. Verify installed behavior. Client-rules remains separate.
